groups.currentProtection: Plaintext in CockroachDB today.
groups.targetProtection: Forbidden in the global DLQ target. Replace with stable error codes and opaque references; move required user payload to a separately user-owned encrypted record.
groups.rationale: Current plaintext can contain user-derived source, but a global record has no safe per-user key or deletion scope.

tables.ownershipNotes: Decision: global DLQ is content-free. Existing source-bearing rows must be redacted/deleted or moved to a new user-owned keyed record before enforcement.

groups.rationale: Required to register, lock, revoke, and retire the exact worker generation without recovering its credential.

groups.currentProtection: One-way SHA-256 verifier of a random generation credential; the original credential is not stored in this table.
groups.targetProtection: Retain a one-way, generation-scoped verifier and constant-purpose comparison boundary; never treat it as encrypted recoverable data.
groups.rationale: Worker authorization compares a process-supplied random credential with this verifier and never needs to recover the original value.

tables.ownershipNotes: Installation-scoped, ephemeral authority for the packaged worker generation. It is excluded from portable backup and a restored or restarted installation registers fresh authority.
